# RAPP Work

RAPP Work is the business policy layer over RAPP/1.

Before acting:

1. Read `SPEC.md`.
2. Use `/rapp-workspace-manager` as the main entrypoint for creating and
   registering local workspaces.
3. Use `protocols/rapp-hive/1/SPEC.md` for work inside one sovereign Private
   Hive.
4. Use `protocols/rapp-federation/1/SPEC.md` for voluntary cross-Hive
   interaction.
5. Use the project skills in
   [`kody-w/rapp-workspace`](https://github.com/kody-w/rapp-workspace) for
   workspace migration and deployment.

Never weaken RAPP/1 identity, frame, hash, signature, egg, or registry rules.
Never infer authority from a transport, repository, account, URL, or actor
type. DOGG must be PII-free. GODD remains private and explicit.
